title: Valley National Bancorp to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Earnings
summary: NEW YORK, July 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Valley National Bancorp ( NASDAQ:VLY ), the holding company for Valley National Bank, announced that it will release its second quarter 2026 earnings before the market opens on Thursday, July 23, 2026. Valley’s CEO, Ira Robbins will host a conference call on Thursday, July 23, 2026 at 8:30 AM (ET) to discuss Valley’s second quarter 2026 earnings. Interested parties should pre-register using this link: https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIa32f14968eef4df5a4b661a7cf4718a7 to receive the dial-in number and a personal PIN, which are required to access the conference call. The teleconference will also be webcast live: https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/gny2asas and archived on Valley’s website through Monday, August 24, 2026. Investor presentation materials will be made available prior to the conference call at www.valley.com .
